_comment: Machine-readable include/exclude decision table for every skill the conversion had to decide about: the 35 skills in claude-account-export/skills/ and the 41 Anthropic built-ins in claude-account-export/platform-skills/{public,examples}/. It is the machine form of MAPPING.md (exported skills) and governance/PLATFORM_SKILLS_DECISION.md (platform skills) - those documents stay the prose record, this file is what scripts/verify_conversion.py enforces so a skill can never be silently dropped or silently deployed. Harness skills (Claude Code environment) are recorded in 'harness_skills' for completeness and are NOT enforced: no kit component corresponds to them. Never hand-edit a decision without the approval recorded in governance/HUMAN_APPROVAL.md (a decision change is a Tier-B change, operations/CHANGE_MANAGEMENT.md).
_owner_note: Accountable owner of every decision below (team/TEAM_MODEL.md): the platform owner. 'date' is the date the decision was recorded in this table, not the date the agent was deployed.

decision_values.AGENT: Converted to a Foundry agent and deployed (subject to requires_flag).
decision_values.ALIAS: Converted and byte-verified, but served by another agent's deployment; the name is registered as a second trigger description.
decision_values.KNOWLEDGE-PACK: Not an agent: the rules are re-authored as an ENX knowledge pack under agents/knowledge-packs/ and attached to the agents that need them.
decision_values.SUPERSEDED: A platform component provides the function (Logic App, script, overlay); any agent shell kept is named in 'agent'.
decision_values.EXCLUDED: Not converted and not deployed - no assurance use, or no meaning on this platform.

field_reference.id: Unique key '<origin>/<skill>'. The same skill name can appear twice (account-synced copy + platform built-in); 'duplicate_of' links them.
field_reference.account_synced: true when the skill is in the account export (skills/ wins over the platform copy of the same name - convert_skills.py).
field_reference.agent: Foundry agent name when one exists, else null.
field_reference.tier: Model tier (light | chat | reasoning) from integrations/registry.json; null when no agent.
field_reference.deployed: true when create_agents.py / create_delivery_agents.py publishes it.
field_reference.requires_flag: convert_skills.py flag needed to build it ('--include-examples'), else null.
field_reference.target: The kit component that carries the decision (agent build dir, knowledge pack, workflow, script).
field_reference.alias_of: For ALIAS: the agent that actually serves this name.
field_reference.duplicate_of: For a platform copy whose account-synced twin is the converted one.
field_reference.superseded_by: For SUPERSEDED: the component that provides the function.
field_reference.rationale: Why - in ENX terms, not Anthropic terms.
field_reference.record: Prose record this decision was taken in.

enforcement._comment: Assertions scripts/verify_conversion.py runs against this file (shared delta: wire them in). Every check is decidable offline from the export tree, build/manifest.json and integrations/registry.json.
checks: C1 every folder under claude-account-export/skills/ holding a SKILL.md has exactly one entry with origin 'export'; every folder under platform-skills/public and platform-skills/examples has exactly one entry (no folder without a decision, no decision without a folder).
C2 ids are unique and counts.* equals the number of entries per origin.
C3 decision is one of decision_values; tier (when set) is one of integrations/registry.json model_tiers.

C4 decision AGENT + deployed true => build/manifest.json holds 'agent' (skipped when requires_flag was not passed to convert_skills.py), and integrations/registry.json lists it under agents or example_agents.

C5 decision EXCLUDED => 'agent' is null and the skill name is NOT in build/manifest.json unless its requires_flag was passed (built-for-fidelity only, never deployed: deployed must be false and the name must not be in integrations/registry.json agents).
C6 decision KNOWLEDGE-PACK => 'agent' is null and the file named in 'target' exists.
C7 decision SUPERSEDED => 'superseded_by' names an existing kit path; if an agent shell is kept, C4 applies to it.
C8 decision ALIAS => 'alias_of' names another entry whose decision is AGENT, and create_orchestrator.py registers the alias (convert_skills.ALIASES).
C9 entries with duplicate_of must carry the same decision as the entry they point at (an account-synced skill and its platform twin can never diverge).
C10 every entry has a non-empty rationale, owner and date.

notes: The forensic-persona skill was withheld from the export for data-protection reasons; it has no folder here and therefore no entry (MAPPING.md 'Exclusions').

Eight Foundry-only agents are converted from no skill (orchestrator, advisor, output-verifier and the five delivery agents) - they are out of scope for this table; see REQUIREMENTS.md and integrations/registry.json.
Building a skill is not deploying it: 'import-memory' and the seven EXCLUDED example skills are built by --include-examples for fidelity but are never published (deployed=false).
